question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Lacking interest or excitement
solution:
The correct answer is '**Mundane**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Mundane**'.
 
• It means 'ordinary; not interesting or exciting'. (साधारण, मामूली; रोचक या उत्तेजक नहीं)
 
 
• *Example: a **mundane** job...*
